overlay_surface_label: Example State official voter-information first-load overlay and answer-lane visibility policy
delivery_role_note: First-load overlay controls keep cookie/consent and privacy/policy notices subordinate to the public answer lane so optional consent or broken overlay components do not become the reason a voter cannot read the current official answer.
optional_consent_boundary_note: Optional tracking, experimentation, or personalization consent is not required to read the current official answer or reach the ordinary help lane.
answer_lane_visibility_note: Critical public-answer routes keep the core answer and help lane visible and legible even when an administrative first-load overlay appears.
dismissibility_and_close_control_note: The overlay exposes clear close or choice controls, supports keyboard dismissal where appropriate, and does not strand the voter behind an undismissable mask.
focus_zoom_and_mobile_obscuration_note: The office reviews focus visibility, zoom, portrait/landscape mobile behavior, and small-viewport control visibility so the overlay does not obscure the answer or the active control.
dismissal_side_effects_note: Dismissing or rejecting the overlay removes the overlay but does not silently swap the page to a different answer route or blank shell.
overlay_component_dependency_note: If a consent manager or overlay component fails, the route fails open to a readable first-party answer or help lane rather than staying blocked.
